name: WEconnect Recovery
one_liner: Peer support recovery app with virtual meetings and clinical monitoring

short_description: Peer support recovery app for substance use and mental health featuring virtual meetings led by peer specialists, 1:1 coaching, and clinical team monitoring das
long_description: WEconnect Recovery is a comprehensive addiction recovery app founded by individuals in long-term recovery, offering virtual peer support meetings from 7 AM to 11 PM across all time zones. General meetings follow guided themes like forgiveness or gratitude, while specialty meetings cater to specific groups including women, veterans, mothers, and LGBTQIA+ members. All meetings are led by peer support specialists with personal recovery experience. The app builds personalized recovery routines with reminders and a rewards system where completing recovery activities earns digital gift cards. The free version includes journaling, meditation, and unlimited daily meetings. Premium subscriptions provide 1:1 peer support coaching. For clinical teams, the platform offers a HIPAA-compliant data dashboard to monitor patient progress and receive relapse risk alerts. 84% of members report it has helped with their recovery.

The free version includes unlimited virtual meetings, journaling, and meditation. Premium subscriptions with 1:1 peer coaching cost $40/month or $350/year, and some insurance plans cover it.
Yes, WEconnect offers specialty meetings at least once daily for specific groups including women, veterans, mothers, and LGBTQIA+ members, in addition to general themed meetings.
